includes: biaya administrasi/biaya komisi/fee platform/ujrah yang setara
excludes: biaya tanda tangan elektronik yang diamankan dengan sertifikat elektronik
manfaat_ekonomi_definition.note_en: Fees are inside the cap. A lender cannot quote a low interest rate and load the rest into admin fees.

formula.denominator_basis: nilai Pendanaan yang tercantum dalam perjanjian — NOT the amount disbursed
formula.tenor_convention: days; the SE's worked examples use 30-day months (5 bulan = 150, 7 bulan = 210)

caps.label_id: Produktif sampai Rp50 juta, tenor sampai dengan 6 bulan
caps.label_en: Productive up to Rp50m, tenor up to 6 months

caps.label_id: Produktif sampai Rp50 juta, tenor di atas 6 bulan
caps.label_en: Productive up to Rp50m, tenor over 6 months

caps.label_id: Produktif di atas Rp50 juta, semua tenor

denda_caps.note: Late penalties are capped SEPARATELY from manfaat ekonomi, at identical rates. Citation XIV.4.

lock_cap.explanation_id: Seluruh manfaat ekonomi dan denda keterlambatan yang dapat dikenakan tidak melebihi 100% dari nilai Pendanaan dalam perjanjian.
lock_cap.explanation_en: Total economic benefit plus late penalties may not exceed 100% of the contract funding value.

on_no_match.MUST_NOT: Never fall through to undefined, null, or 0. An unmatched combination is not a pass and not a fail.
on_no_match.note: With the bands above, konsumtif and produktif are both fully covered for any tenor and principal. This branch should be unreachable — if it fires, the input parsing is wrong.
on_no_match.ui_id: Kombinasi ini tidak dikenali, jadi pemeriksaan batas tidak bisa diselesaikan. Pastikan ke OJK 157.
on_no_match.ui_en: This combination was not recognised, so the cap check could not be completed. Confirm with OJK 157.
